milestone: DSH2 M2 - Paraphrase synthesis and ambiguity control
implementation: generate_counterfactual_pair / mutate_program / one_fact_proof / dimension_projection / check_pair_prompt_controls / pair_artifact_nodes / embedding_close_negative / topology_negative / constant_baseline_accuracy / marker_permutation
depends_on: dsl.semantic_frame (SLM-363), dsl.paraphrase_provenance (SLM-364), harnesses.train_data.frame_paraphrases (SLM-365 fixture provider + leak detector), harnesses.train_data.artifact_graph + split_policy (root split families)

provider.network: none (fully offline deterministic fixture, no credentials)

controls.one_fact_proof: path-insensitive per-dimension frame projections; admitted only when the declared dimension's projection diff is non-empty, every other dimension's diff is empty, canonical fingerprints differ, and the inverse mutation round-trips to the source canonical AST
controls.matched_style: both prompts rendered by the same style template through the DSH2-03 provider contract; style_mismatch rejects
controls.marker_surface: placeholder markers never rendered (SLM-365 leak floor); state reads neutralized to declaration ordinals; marker_permutation of both sources leaves prompts and proof unchanged; marker_surface_cue / leak_detected reject, cross-checked against both frames' detectors
controls.split_family: counterfactual inherits the source root_family_id; RootFamilySplitPolicyV1 assigns both to one split; artifact graph quarantines cross-split surface reuse
controls.stop_rule: any uncontrolled semantic or surface cue rejects with a code (REJECTION_CODES) and is never counted as grounding evidence
